question: Which of the following results in increase in secretion of ADH?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Hypervolemia" -> "increased blood volume" -> "decreased secretion of ADH" -> 10%
CHAIN: "Hypotension" -> "decreased blood pressure" -> "increased secretion of ADH" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Hypovolemia" -> "decreased blood volume" -> "increased secretion of ADH" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Decrease osmolarity" -> "lower solute concentration in blood" -> "decreased secretion of ADH" -> 15%
analysis: Hypovolemia directly decreases blood volume, a critical condition that triggers the body to conserve water to maintain essential functions. This leads to an increase in ADH secretion, aligning with its primary role in water balance regulation. This option is supported by standard physiological principles.
